description: Project-specific prose-quality patterns (criteria R4, R5, R6 from the original method). Replace patterns with your project's own. Lists left empty disable the corresponding check.
acronym_note: R4: every acronym listed here must be expanded at first use in the text (e.g. 'service-level agreement (SLA)').
overexplanation_note: R5: flag definitions that restate what the formula already says.
caveat_note: R6: the same caveat should appear inline at most `caveat_max_per_section` times per section, except in sections exempted by `caveat_exempt_regex` (threats/limitations sections repeat caveats legitimately).
